Table. Estimates of Evolutionary Divergence between Sequences
The number of amino acid substitutions per site from between sequences are shown. Analyses were conducted using the Poisson correction model [1]. This analysis involved 40 amino acid sequences. All positions containing gaps and missing data were eliminated (complete deletion option). There were a total of 5921 positions in the final dataset. Evolutionary analyses were conducted in MEGA11 [2][3]
